const long long MOD = 1000000007;

long long S[65][35][35][35], A[65][35][35][35], P[65][35][35][35], Aux[35][35];
pair <long long, long long> X[105];

void copyMatrix(long long X[][35], long long Y[][35], long long n) {
    for (long long i = 0; i < n; i++)
        for (long long j = 0; j < n; j++)
            X[i][j] = Y[i][j];
}

inline void addMod(long long& x, long long y) {
    x += y;
    if (x >= MOD) x -= MOD;
}

void multiplyMatrices(long long X[][35], long long Y[][35], long long Z[][35], long long n, long long m, long long p) {
    for (long long i = 0; i < n; i++)
        for (long long j = 0; j < p; j++) {
            Z[i][j] = 0;
            for (long long k = 0; k < m; k++)
                addMod(Z[i][j], (X[i][k] * Y[k][j]) % MOD);
        }
}

void precomputeA() {
    for (long long x = 0; x < K; x++) {
        for (long long i = 0; i < K + 1; i++) A[0][x][i][i] = 1;
        for (long long j = 0; j < K + 1; j++) A[0][x][j][x] = 1;
    }
    copyMatrix(P[0][0], A[0][0], K + 1);
    copyMatrix(S[0][K - 1], A[0][K - 1], K + 1);
    for (long long x = 1; x < K; x++)
        multiplyMatrices(P[0][x - 1], A[0][x], P[0][x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
    for (long long x = K - 2; x >= 0; x--)
        multiplyMatrices(A[0][x], S[0][x + 1], S[0][x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
    long long cnt = 1;
    for (long long m = K; m <= N; m *= K, cnt++) {
        for (long long x = 0; x < K; x++) {
            if (x > 0) {
                copyMatrix(A[cnt][x], S[cnt - 1][x], K + 1);
                multiplyMatrices(A[cnt][x], P[cnt - 1][x - 1], Aux, K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
                copyMatrix(A[cnt][x], Aux, K + 1);
            } else {
                copyMatrix(A[cnt][x], S[cnt - 1][x], K + 1);
            }
        }
        copyMatrix(P[cnt][0], A[cnt][0], K + 1);
        copyMatrix(S[cnt][K - 1], A[cnt][K - 1], K + 1);
        for (long long x = 1; x < K; x++)
            multiplyMatrices(P[cnt][x - 1], A[cnt][x], P[cnt][x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
        for (long long x = K - 2; x >= 0; x--)
            multiplyMatrices(A[cnt][x], S[cnt][x + 1], S[cnt][x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
        if (m > N / K) break;
    }
}

int main() {
    cin >> N >> K;
    Power[0] = 1;
    int i = 1;
    while (Power[i - 1] <= N / K) {
        Power[i] = Power[i - 1] * K;
        ++i;
    }
    int ind = i - 1;
    precomputeA();
    long long init = N, last = -1, count = -1, ind2 = 0;
    Res[0][K] = 1;
    for (int i = ind; i >= 0; i--) {
        while (Power[i] <= init) {
            multiplyMatrices(Res, A[i][ind2], Aux, K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
            copyMatrix(Res, Aux, K + 1);
            ind2++;
            if (ind2 == K) ind2 = 0;
            init -= Power[i];
        }
    }
    long long ans = 0;
